findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hiring_posts, company_lookup, networking_plan, post_job · Private data: company_lookup, find_people, us_visa_salaries · Public sink: hiring_posts, employer_reply_rate, referral_note, join_matching, post_job, interview_practice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hiring_posts, company_lookup, networking_plan, post_job · Private data: company_lookup, find_people, us_visa_salaries · Public sink: hiring_posts, employer_reply_rate, referral_note, join_matching, post_job, interview_practice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
